Zach / team —

Posting a short technical appendix to clarify the items Ben and Elliot referenced. This is intended to be attached to the Availability Annex as an "Evidence & Behavior Appendix."

1) Measurement points / uptime calculation- Availability is calculated per calendar month as: (Total seconds in month - total seconds of measured service outage) / (Total seconds in month). Measurement points: edge LB healthchecks + service-level API monitor from each configured region (us-west-2 and us-east-1 by default).

2) Exclusions- Scheduled maintenance (>=72 hours notice), customer-caused outages (e.g., network ACLs blocking traffic), force majeure. We can enumerate maintenance windows in the exhibit if Medilogic wants a blackout policy.

3) Fallback routing semantics- If the Dedicated pool reports degraded performance (latency > configured threshold and error rates > configured threshold), Redwood routing tries in order: (1) standby dedicated pool (if configured), (2) alternate-region dedicated pool (if customer has regional replication), (3) model-compatible hosted variant. Each step is attempt-based with circuit-breaker heuristics and will surface an event to the customer's incident feed.

4) Evidence we can provide- Monthly latency percentiles (p50, p95), per-request traces for incident windows (redacted), audit logs showing routing events, SOC 2 report (scope documents), and a sanitized sample of KV cache hit-rate distributions. Note: we will not disclose customer payloads; traces will be redacted per our data protection policy.

5) Credit calculation (summary)- See attached spreadsheet. Credits trigger when Availability < thresholds in the credit table; credits are pro-rated against the affected month’s invoice and applied in the next billing cycle. We store metric and billing events for 18 months.

Attachments referenced inline: service-architecture-diagram.png (PNG, 220KB)

If you want, I can add a short param table showing the exact thresholds (e.g., p95 latency target 450ms, availability target 99.95%) — confirm whether Medilogic wants both latency targets and availability in the annex or availability only.

Thanks,
